question: Does one analytically constructed nine-point pair share power but differ in local triple counts?
reason_for_separate_continuation: Completed phase 2 found no non-dihedral pair in either declared small family. Retain that absence; test a single direct-sum construction rather than enlarging the search.
assumptions: Collision-free direct sums produce binary words. Equality of integer cyclic autocorrelation entails equal Fourier power.
cross_domain: Local word counts are a diagnostic counterexample for power-only inference, not geometric tile legality.
protected: No infinite aperiodicity or Einstein tile claim

budget.case_bound: Exactly one candidate pair, 54 dihedral comparisons and 325 triple-offset comparisons. No retries except one unchanged replay.

acceptance: Report equal power, equivalence and triple witness separately; Pass means completed instrument, not assumed non-equivalence.
